slides.alt: A small green note and a large red note above the grid, and a faint blue note on the board, beside the Text Anywhere panel with its nine colors, Size slider and Opacity slider
slides.caption: Nine colors (keys 1-9), Size and Opacity; + and - step the size

slides.alt: A bold red formula, A+B=11, on a cell edge with no box, and a red formula, X+Y=2Z, in a page-colored box that hides the grid lines under it

slides.caption: Select: drag a box round notes, then change them together; drag to move, arrow keys nudge

slides.alt: The board with no notes showing, beside the Text Anywhere panel with a red ring on its pressed eye button, which shows a closed eye
slides.caption: The eye hides every note to show the board; click it again to bring them back

slides.caption: The settings: font, halo, box color and border, color presets
